chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 462 – Han Li’s Blood Jade Spider Trap: How Two Nascent Soul Wolves Negotiate Over a Mortal
chapter_meta_description: In Chapter 462 of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality, Extreme Yin Patriarch and Qingyi Hermit corner Han Li over the Blood Jade Spider. A masterclass in cultivation-world power politics.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 462 – When Two Wolves Negotiate Over You
og_description: Extreme Yin Patriarch and Qingyi Hermit have cut their deal off-screen. Han Li’s last threat—self-destructing the Blood Jade Spider—has been countered by a worse one. The game has new rules.
twitter_title: RMJI 462 – The Silence Before the Deal
twitter_description: Two Nascent Soul cultivators settle Han Li’s fate with a sound transmission. He never even heard the negotiation.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare spirit beast considered one of the best vessels for retrieving the sealed Void Heaven Tripod; its value makes any cultivator who owns it a target.
A classical Chinese idiom describing a weakling who gains power by being associated with a stronger figure; Han Li uses this to dismiss Wu Chou’s bluster.
A private communication method using spiritual sense, undetectable by third parties unless they possess a far higher cultivation level or a specialized detection art.
A refined undead body created from a slain creature; usable as a substitute for a living spirit beast in certain rituals, albeit with reduced power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li’s self-destruct threat fail?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Extreme Yin Patriarch reveals a workaround: killing the spider and refining it into a Corpse Puppet, which makes Han Li replaceable, not indispensable.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Qingyi Hermit mention Man Brutal Beard?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To introduce a silent third-party threat into the negotiation—a name powerful enough to force Extreme Yin to compromise rather than risk the secret leaking to an even stronger competitor.
A private, inaudible conversation between cultivators using their spiritual sense; anyone outside the loop cannot overhear it, making it a perfect tool for off-screen deal-making.
